mcqs.q: What does a gene code for?
options: Typically a polypeptide (protein) — through transcription to mRNA and translation by ribosomes.
A gene codes for a specific physical feature like eye colour directly.
Each gene codes for an organ or body part as a whole.
X-linked conditions affect only males because females cannot inherit X-linked alleles.

mcqs.q: Why is a reflex action faster than a conscious response?
options: The signal does not need to be processed by the brain — it travels through a simpler reflex arc via the spinal cord.
Each gene codes for an organ or body part as a whole.
Reflexes are faster because they use specially fast neurones not used elsewhere.
The brain decides reflexes faster than other actions because it skips thinking.

mcqs.q: Why are X-linked recessive conditions more common in males?
options: X-linked recessive conditions affect more males because the Y chromosome makes the disease worse.
X-linked conditions affect only males because females cannot inherit X-linked alleles.
Reflexes are faster because they use specially fast neurones not used elsewhere.
Males have only one X chromosome, so a single recessive allele is expressed — there's no second X to mask it.
